chunks.text: I’m heading out from Beijing to Shanghai soon, just trying to keep the whole trip straight in my head.
And I’m planning a few low-key days in Suzhou too, kind of a little breather in the middle of everything.
Before all that, I’m still in Beijing for a bit and I want to squeeze in some classic attractions around the city while I’m here.
For the flight piece, I’ve got MU5678 with China Eastern on 2026-03-27, and it’s under the passenger name Yang Yu.

Then in Suzhou I’m staying at Home Inn Pingjiang—checking in 2026-03-02 for 4 nights, and the guest name on that is Ethan Thomas, which I keep double-checking because I always mix it up with my other confirmations, and after that I’m thinking about…
